content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Identify the vertex (turning point) of a quadratic graph
Find the roots (solutions) where the graph crosses the $x$-axis
Determine the line of symmetry of a parabola
Sketch quadratic graphs using key features
Every quadratic graph has the same basic parabolic shape, but they differ in their position, width, and orientation. By understanding the key features -- the
-- you can quickly sketch a quadratic or extract information from its graph. Engineers use these features to model projectile paths, optimise designs, and solve real-world problems.
